functions.name: GetArchiveName
functions.docs:
Returns the name of the Archive.  Useful for getting the name of the package a struct or object
is in when a loading error occurs.
This is overridden for the specific Archive Types

functions.name: TotalSize
functions.docs: Gets the total size of the data written

functions.name: GetData
functions.docs: Returns the written data. To release this archive's ownership of the data, call ReleaseOwnership()

functions.name: GetView
functions.docs:
Returns a view on the written data
The view does not own the memory, so you must make sure you keep the memory writer
alive while you are using the returned view.

functions.name: ReleaseOwnership
functions.docs:
Releases ownership of the written data
Also returns the pointer, so that the caller only needs to call this function to take control
of the memory.

functions.name: Reserve
functions.docs: Reserves memory such that the writer can contain at least Size number of bytes.
